key.name: equalizer-presets
key.summary: User-saved equalizer presets in tenths of a decibel
key.description: Saved only on explicit user request and applied only when selected. They are never automatically replayed.

key.name: headset-address
key.description: Empty selects the only paired Momentum 4 headset. Source devices are selected from the headset's own paired-device list.

key.name: show-battery-percentage
key.summary: Show valid battery percentage in the panel

key.name: momentum4-toggle-menu
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens or closes the menu
key.description: Empty disables the shortcut. The name is unique because Mutter keybinding names are global.
